summary: Feature 'pre-existing-capsule-path-validation' PASSES review. The fix correctly implements path traversal and absolute path validation in src/mcp/tools/capsule.ts. All 27 tests in tests/security/capsule-path-validation.test.ts pass. The implementation uses containsTraversal(), isAbsolutePath(), and isPathWithinRoot() to return proper error objects with isError: true for all security violations. Zod schema validation via .refine() and .max() is complemented by runtime validation in the handler to ensure errors are properly returned when path/glob parameters contain '..' segments, exceed 4096 characters, or represent absolute paths outside the project root.
